title: Coordinate-ratio equation for a section-preserving projective pair
statement: Let $X,S$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $I$ a coordinate type, $M$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module, $s_i\in\Gamma(X,M)$, and $\varphi:X\to\mathbf P(I;S)$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. Suppose an isomorphism $\varepsilon:\varphi^*\mathcal O(1)\to M$ [def-pc-projective-space-twist, def-pc-module-pullback] sends every pulled-back coordinate $T_i$ to $s_i$. Then on $\varphi^{-1}D_+(T_i)$ one has $s_j=\varphi^*(T_j/T_i)s_i$ for every $i,j\in I$. In fact this equation only needs a module morphism $\varepsilon$ with the displayed section equations.

proof.text: Pull the coordinate identity T_j=(T_j/T_i)T_i back to the chart and apply ε. O-linearity preserves the pulled-back scalar, and naturality moves ε through restriction. Substitute the section equations for ε. This is source map_eq_coordRatio_smul_of_twistRestrict_iso (OfInvertible.lean:317-324), proved by applying ε to pullbackSection_twistOneSection_map_eq_smul.
